title: packet-iec104.c - Add IEC 60870-5-103 Protocol Dissection
description:
- IEC 60870-5-103 is a derivative protocol of the main 101/104 variants.
- It is used primarily for RTU to IED communication and facilitates
collection of basic status, metering and fault data with several same or
similar field types and data formatting.
- This protocol is primarily serial-only but it can be present on
Ethernet-tunneled-serial communication circuits if port servers are used.
- This initial version supports the following ASDU Types:
Prim-to-Sec (RTU-to-IED): Types 6, 7, 20, 45/46 (private)
Sec-to-Prim (IED-to-RTU): Types 1, 5, 6, 8, 9, 205 (private)

notes.body:
Here are some sample PCAP files providing examples of the supported ASDU types (use right-click decode-as to configure the RTAC Serial-Line dissection as IEC 103).[iec103_asdu1_6_7_8_9.pcap](/uploads/6c6eb65be80cdb92028ae8552b93092e/iec103_asdu1_6_7_8_9.pcap)

[iec103_asdu205.pcap](/uploads/b7c9eccb7539031e36c337556aa71c1f/iec103_asdu205.pcap)

[iec103_asdu1_5_20_45_46.pcap](/uploads/496922fdf33fce9a50ebb548c03fb00b/iec103_asdu1_5_20_45_46.pcap)
FYI @graham.bloice, this may be of interest.
Thanks @cbontje , I usually work on the other side of the RTU interface so have never seen -103 before.
